patch.objective: Following and executing a planned strategy or framework (e.g., for communication or risk), and explaining the benefit of project initiation and planning

sources.cite: PMI, Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) Examination Content Outline, 2023 Exam Update: Fundamentals and Core Concepts 36%, Predictive Plan-Based Methodologies 17%, Agile Frameworks/Methodologies 20%, Business Analysis Frameworks 27%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of a copy of PMI's PDF hosted by a university. Relevant text: Domain 1 Task 5 'Demonstrate an understanding of common problem-solving tools and techniques' ('Evaluate the effectiveness of a meeting'; 'Explain the purpose of focus groups, standup meetings, brainstorming, etc.'); Domain 2 Task 2 ('Apply critical path methods'; 'Calculate schedule variance') and Task 3 ('Calculate cost and schedule variances'). The objective wording here is the course seed's.

The food distributor, the project, the probabilities, impacts, costs and support gauges are fictional teaching figures for exam practice, not measured values. Expected monetary value is probability times impact: 0.4 x 500 = 200 thousand dollars before the response, 0.1 x 500 = 50 after it.
